template:
# Wait for the 1.5.0 rollout to finish (fails after 5 minutes)
kubectl rollout {{0}} deployment/notes-api --timeout=5m

# It's failing in production: list revisions, then go back one
kubectl rollout {{1}} deployment/notes-api
kubectl rollout {{2}} deployment/notes-api

# On the Helm-managed staging cluster, return to release revision 4
helm {{3}} notes-api 4 -n notes
